突き込む: to delve into (a matter); to go into depth; to get to the heart (of something)
退く: to step aside; to move (out of the way); to make way
対する: to be directed toward (the future, etc.); to be in response to; to be related to
現われる: to appear; to come in sight; to become visible; to come out
勧める: to offer (a drink, cigarette, seat, etc.)
頂点: top (of a profession, field, etc.); summit
上り詰める: to go to the top; to climb to the top; to ascend to the top; to reach the summit (e.g. of a mountain)
見逃す: to let pass (a matter); to overlook (e.g. a wrongdoing); to turn a blind eye to
